title: feat: implement Q1 2026 roadmap — accessibility, responsive design, i18n deep integration
body:
Implements all Q1 2026 Foundation & v2.0.7 Alignment items from ROADMAP.md, bringing spec compliance from 82% → 86% by consuming 10+ new `@objectstack/spec` v2.0.7 types across accessibility, responsive design, and i18n domains.

## Accessibility — AriaPropsSchema & WcagContrastLevel

- **SchemaRenderer** now extracts `ariaLabel`, `ariaDescribedBy`, `role` from schema nodes and injects them as standard HTML ARIA attributes. Supports `I18nLabel` objects via `resolveI18nLabel()`.
- **ThemeEngine** gains `contrastRatio(hex1, hex2)` and `meetsContrastLevel(hex1, hex2, 'AA'|'AAA', isLargeText)` — WCAG 2.1 luminance-based contrast checking.
- **axe-core** test suite added (9 tests) validating Shadcn primitives against WCAG 2.1 AA.

```tsx
// AriaProps flow through SchemaRenderer automatically
<SchemaRenderer schema={{
  type: 'button',
  ariaLabel: { key: 'nav.close', defaultValue: 'Close' },
  role: 'navigation',
}} />
// renders: <button aria-label="Close" role="navigation">...</button>

// WCAG contrast validation
meetsContrastLevel('#336699', '#ffffff', 'AA'); // true
contrastRatio('#000000', '#ffffff'); // 21
```

## Responsive Design — Spec Schema Consumers

- **`ResponsiveGrid`** layout component consuming `BreakpointColumnMapSchema` → pure Tailwind CSS grid classes (no JS resize listeners)
- **`useResponsiveConfig`** hook consuming `ResponsiveConfigSchema` + `BreakpointOrderMapSchema` → resolves `{ hidden, columns, order }` at current breakpoint

```tsx
<ResponsiveGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 2, lg: 4 }} gap={4}>
  {items.map(item => <Card key={item.id} />)}
</ResponsiveGrid>
```

## I18n Deep Integration — v2.0.7 Type Consumers

- **`resolvePlural(rule, count, locale)`** — `PluralRuleSchema` consumer using `Intl.PluralRules` for CLDR-correct pluralization
- **`formatDateSpec(date, format, locale)`** — `DateFormatSchema` consumer
- **`formatNumberSpec(value, format, locale)`** — `NumberFormatSchema` consumer  
- **`applyLocaleConfig(config)`** — `LocaleConfigSchema` consumer returning bound formatting functions
- **`I18nProvider`** gains `loadLanguage` prop for dynamic/lazy language pack loading

## Test & Benchmark Infrastructure

- 59 new tests (3020 total), 155 test files, 0 regressions
- Performance benchmark suite via `vitest bench` (ExpressionEvaluator, ComponentRegistry, ThemeEngine)
- Breakpoint utility tests for `@object-ui/mobile`

## Bug Fixes (§1.6) — Verified Already Addressed

DataScope, plugin-ai handlers, DetailView fetching, ObjectMap coordinate validation, and ReportViewer refresh were all verified as already implemented in the codebase. ROADMAP.md updated accordingly.
